why: §5's header declares SEVEN columns -- # | Risk | Severity | Why accepted | Compensating control | Owner | Review by. A row with fewer still RENDERS, because Markdown pads the missing cells, so its owner and its date land in the wrong columns and the last two render EMPTY. PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md §11's merge rule is that a Medium or a Low is "written into PLAN.md §5 with an owner and a date", and a row whose Owner and Review by columns are blank does not satisfy it. Nothing read this table's SHAPE until 2026-11-12.

Muhammad's ruling of 2026-11-12: "The 58 inherited rows: do NOT fix them here. They belong to delivered tickets, and rewriting delivered work from inside another ticket is R-250, which has already recurred twice. Land the shape check with a dated baseline that ENUMERATES all 58 by row id -- never a count, which silently absorbs the next one -- and fail the build on any row not in that list. Same shape as QRPAGER-46's CSS baseline. The ten you repaired are this ticket's own and stay repaired; the 58 become visible debt with a guard behind them."

So this file is a FREEZE, not a fix. The ten rows QRPAGER-47 itself malformed -- R-304...R-313 -- are REPAIRED and are deliberately absent from this list. The 58 below span R-108 to R-296 and belong to other tickets.
ENUMERATED BY ROW ID AND NEVER BY A COUNT, which is the ruling's own reason: a count silently absorbs the next malformed row, and the whole point of the guard is that the 59th is red.

THE OBSERVED WIDTH IS RECORDED BESIDE EACH ROW, for the reason QRPAGER-46's baseline records a count: keying on the id alone would let a frozen row get WORSE -- six cells to four -- without a word. A width that no longer matches is red, and so is a row in this list that now has seven cells, because a baseline claiming debt the repository no longer carries is a false record in the direction nobody checks.

MATCHING IS BACKTICK-AWARE. Several §5 rows quote a shell pipeline inside a code span -- §0's own prescribed command has two pipes -- so splitting on every | reported 78 malformed rows where there are 68. A pipe inside backticks is content; only a bare one is a cell boundary.
